concept: A few separate filaments join a richly woven whole, giving newcomers an intuitive sense of distinct reasoning supporting one coherent result. Shared crossings imply that a strand can contribute in several places.
composition: Center a compact, luminous woven medallion on a deep charcoal field, with generous negative space. Three or four clearly visible filaments enter from different edges, curve inward, and remain distinct briefly before interlacing. Keep the central subject large and readable in a narrow mobile crop.
strands: Give each filament a subtly different texture or warm-neutral tone. In the weave, let paths cross, branch, and reunite organically, including shared crossings. Show no count, order, or one-to-one mapping; the whole feels complete through interdependence, not a visible final stage.
brandConnection: Use charcoal, ivory, and restrained antique gold, matching Moriarty’s existing visual identity. Echo its crescent and small star as a delicate engraved detail. Combine Victorian mathematical illustration with tactile textile craftsmanship, kept crisp and contemporary.
avoid: No person, text, labels, numerals, checkmarks, arrows, fixed strand count, pipeline, or staged sequence. Avoid gears, neon circuitry, blockchain globes, generic node-link networks, dashboards, and security-diagram styling. Suggest careful reasoning, not automatic execution.
imagePrompt: Text-free Moriarty Webs and Strands hero art: on charcoal, a centered, mobile-readable woven medallion with a few clearly separate incoming filaments that organically interlace into a richly detailed whole. Use shared crossings, branching and reunion to suggest that one strand can support several parts. Ivory highlights, quiet antique gold, restrained warm light, generous negative space; Victorian mathematical engraving meets fine textile craft. Add a subtle crescent arc and tiny star as a secondary brand echo.
